test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

LEAN : NEAL :: MEAN : NEAM :: HEAR : ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **First and fourth letters are interchanged**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a0a831295fe43344d3d069a217c49cc91f05b0a2709aaa4759812fad7da6aaa.png] 

**LEAN** becomes **NEAL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aad63f2c0964416904c8ab80b2569000c6bc23a14a15a8b4b9707fdd64a8cf8.png] 

**MEAN **becomes** NEAM **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28b71f5a0e1876a0843ed9cb947bcd8120c02e708935e212e9b8651d7d77a9f4.png] 

**HEAR** becomes** REAH **

Hence** **the correct answer is** REAH.**
